info.title: Ship24 Universal API
info.description: Track shipments, search tracking results, manage trackers, and inspect supported couriers with Ship24's Tracking API.

post.description: Creates multiple new trackers in Ship24.

tracker.description: Tracker object returned for created or existing items.

clientTrackerId.description: Your unique identifier for this shipment.

destinationCountryCode.description: Recipient country code. Recommended to improve tracking accuracy.

destinationPostCode.description: Recipient postal or ZIP code. Recommended to improve tracking accuracy.

shippingDate.description: Shipment date. Keep it close to the real ship date to improve matching accuracy.

courierCode[].description: Up to 3 courier codes handling the shipment. Recommended to improve tracking accuracy.

orderNumber.description: Order number when the shipment comes from an ecommerce order.

settings.restrictTrackingToCourierCode.description: If true, Ship24 only tracks the courier codes you provide.

isSubscribed.description: Whether the tracker is active for webhook subscription.
